crossRefs.note: Who will listen to you in this matter? For as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who stays…
Shecaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have trespassed against our God, and have…

translations.web: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?”
translations.bsb: Must we now hear that you too are doing all this terrible evil and acting unfaithfully against our God by marrying foreign women?”
translations.kjv: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?
translations.asv: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?
